text:
Ana (PM): quick sync — proposing a small pilot for a 'micro-reserve' offering: soft reserved pools with limited burst credits + experimental pricing. goal: give midsize customers predictable baseline throughput without full dedicated commitment. thoughts? :eyes:
Sam (Eng): love the idea. main question: how does fallback work when burst > credits? do we preempt, queue, or spill to shared pools?
Liam (Eng-Infra): default plan = graceful spill to shared spot lanes with 95th p90 latency guardrail, then reject at hard limit. can show config: 
```
autoscale_policy: {
  baseline: 50qps,
  burst_credits: 30000tokens,
  spillover_policy: "shared_spot",
  hard_reject_threshold: 120% // of baseline+burst
}
```
Priya (Product Ops): launch criteria proposal (short): 1) 3 pilot customers onboarded 2) telemetry dashboard for per-tenant spillover rate + cost delta 3) billing agreed (flat baseline + burst metering) 4) SLA doc + customer-facing FAQ.
OpsJen (SRE): add acceptance thresholds: spillover-induced errors < 0.5% of requests, end-to-end p95 < baseline+20ms under spill, and no more than 2 incidents requiring manual rollback in pilot window.
Ana (PM): timeline idea: 2-week internal canary -> 4-week external pilot (3 customers) -> decide GA. owners: Sam (implementation), Priya (pilot coordination), Liam (infra rollout), OpsJen (oncall + runbook).
Sam (Eng): implementation notes: need route-level quota hooks + per-tenant token ledger. estimate 3 sprint points (2 weeks) to wire up, plus 1 week to add billing events.
Priya (Product Ops): will draft customer onboarding checklist: opt-in toggle in console, contract addendum, telemetry opt-in. also need pricing experiment matrix (A/B pricing) for 3 pilots.
Liam (Eng-Infra): question about eviction behavior — do we pre-warm shared pools? prewarm + caching makes a big perf diff for bursty workloads. suggest soft-prewarm on expected windows (9–11am local) for pilot.
Ana (PM): agree on prewarm for pilot only. include prewarm toggle in the pilot config.
Jordan-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployment started: reserved-micro:v0.1 -> canary hosts 2/3 -> success :white_check_mark:
OpsJen (SRE): I'll add a runbook step: if spillover_rate > 5% for > 15m, trigger investigation and optional throttle rollback. add Pager duty rule.
Sam (Eng): PR checklist I'll own: unit tests for quota ledger, integration test for spillover path, a smoke test that simulates burst > credits.
Priya (Product Ops): customer comms: short note + opt-in form. i'll draft copy and share.
Ana (PM): acceptance sign-off criteria (final): - pilot customers complete 4-week trial with metrics within thresholds - product & infra postmortem w/ cost delta analysis - docs + console flows published - legal ok for billing terms
Liam (Eng-Infra): any objections to GA gating on latency regression < 5% p95 across pilot tenants? if not, let's lock it.
OpsJen (SRE): +1 on latency gate. also require instrumentation for request attribution (tenant_id + reserve_flag).
Ana (PM): thanks all — can we confirm owners in thread and I'll schedule kick-off? :thumbsup:
Sam (Eng): Sam (implementation) :thumbsup:
